drafter.private_reasoning: The draft appears to be on behalf of the employer. Counter with a defined, conditional severance package rather than accepting 18 months payable unconditionally. Offer deletion of the non-compete to advance negotiations, subject to client approval and agreement on the overall package. Do not invent missing commercial terms or disclose confidential client information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Subject to our client’s approval and agreement on the overall package, we propose 12 months’ Base Salary and up to 12 months of employer-funded health coverage continuation following termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, conditioned on an effective release. Salary severance would be paid through regular payroll without mitigation or offset for subsequent earnings; health support would end upon eligibility for comparable employer coverage. We have proposed narrow Cause and Good Reason definitions, including notice and cure where appropriate. As part of that package, we propose deleting the non-compete. We are seeking confirmation of the Executive’s identity, effective date, salary, benefits, work location and governing law and have left those items open rather than inserting assumptions. All proposals remain subject to client approval and definitive documentation.

edits.text: PARTIES; EFFECTIVE DATE. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the Company) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the Executive), effective as of [date].
1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer. The Executive’s principal work location shall be [location to be agreed].

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of [amount and currency] (Base Salary), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and applicable law, and shall be eligible to participate in [benefit plans to be agreed], subject to their applicable terms.

3. TERMINATION; SEVERANCE. Upon any termination, the Company shall pay earned but unpaid Base Salary, reimbursable business expenses and other accrued entitlements required by applicable law or applicable benefit plans. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall additionally provide: (a) severance equal to 12 months of Base Salary at the rate in effect immediately before termination, disregarding any reduction giving rise to Good Reason, paid in installments through regular payroll; and (b) subject to timely election and eligibility, payment of the employer portion of premiums for continuation of the Executive’s existing group health coverage for up to 12 months, ending earlier upon eligibility for comparable coverage from another employer. These additional benefits are conditioned on the Executive executing and not revoking a reasonable release of employment-related claims in favor of the Company, excluding rights under this Agreement and claims that cannot lawfully be released, within 60 days after termination. Salary severance shall commence on the first regular payroll date after that 60-day period, with a catch-up payment for installments otherwise payable during that period, subject to applicable tax requirements. The Executive shall have no duty to mitigate, and salary severance shall not be reduced by subsequent earnings. Cause means fraud, embezzlement or intentional misappropriation involving the Company; conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; or willful misconduct or a willful material breach of this Agreement that materially harms the Company. Cause requires written notice specifying the grounds and, where curable, failure to cure within 30 days after receipt. Good Reason means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary, a material diminution of duties or authority, relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or the Company’s material breach of this Agreement. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the Executive learns of the condition, failure by the Company to cure within 30 days after receipt, and resignation within 30 days after expiration of the cure period.

4. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [jurisdiction to be agreed], subject to mandatory applicable law. No post-employment non-compete restriction is imposed by this Agreement.
Executive’s full legal name and effective date remain to be confirmed.
Salary amount, currency, payroll frequency and specific benefit arrangements remain to be confirmed.

Proposed counteroffer, subject to client approval. Payment and health-continuation mechanics require review under the agreed jurisdiction’s employment and tax rules, including Section 409A if applicable.
Non-compete deletion is proposed as part of the overall package, subject to client approval. Governing law and principal work location remain open.
